mission.paragraph_1: We begin with hull-form design, one of the core disciplines of naval architecture, and extend AI transformation across marine engineering—so that anyone can design an optimized vessel.
mission.paragraph_2: MAX-Hull unifies 3D geometry generation informed by hydrodynamic performance, AI flow-field prediction that replaces hours of CFD, and trusted legacy systems. Together with Agent MAX, it enables ship design that is accurate, fast, and economical.
